lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Primary high-intensity circular maxima are arranged in approximately seven quasi-linear vertical columns between the pectoral fin insertion and the first dorsal fin apex. Central clusters exhibit a higher density of larger diameter blobs compared to the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Horizontal longitudinal ridges intersect with faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity to form a coordinate-like grid; the highest-luminance blobs are localized at the center of these grid quadrants.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the flank, each defined by a high-luminance upper edge and a shadowed lower edge. The primary mid-lateral ridge maintains a linear trajectory from the posterior gill margin to the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 14 distinct high-luminance spots; density is highest in the anterior-basal region, with spots becoming smaller and more disparate toward the distal and posterior margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal margin of the left pectoral fin exhibits irregular notches and marginal tissue loss. A minor notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique 'U-shaped' arrangement of four high-intensity spots is located in the mid-lateral field posterior to the fifth gill slit. An elongated dark silhouette (likely an Echeneidae specimen) is visible attached to the ventral-lateral surface.
